verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly offer scoped API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows login and registration, acting 'em representação' (on behalf of someone else), and services for certified accountants, which are human delegation features rather than agent API credentials. The llms.txt probe returned 404, and nothing documents issuing API keys, tokens or least-privilege scopes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
